examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Badge Content
examples.description: This example uses the value parameter of BadgeParamWithNumber and the count parameter of BadgeParamWithString to display different effects when the Badge component receives an empty value, a character, or a number.

examples.title: Example 2: Controlling the Badge Visibility with Numbers
examples.description: This example shows how to use the count property to toggle the visibility of the Badge component. Specifically, when the count property is set to 0, the badge is hidden; when it is set to 1, the badge becomes visible.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Outer Border and Text Extension Mode
examples.description: Since API version 22, this example uses the outerBorderColor and outerBorderWidth attributes to set the outer border, and uses the enableAutoAvoidance attribute to set whether to avoid the badge text extension.
